Kling 4.0 just landed on Pika. It's the most control Kling has ever given you, with omni reference, multi-keyframes, and generations up to 30 seconds long. You may now make the scene that's been living in your head.

Try Kling 4.0 on Pika:
 https://lnkd.in/gpE5CjMV 

Or build with it through the Pika API Club:
 https://lnkd.in/gjQKvMuN
